history.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create a flat, elegant UNLABELLED PNG background for a Chinese textbook hierarchical research-question sunburst. A circular FAN / annular-sector hierarchy, not a card diagram. It is a map of machine learning theory: three main themes, eight subthemes, fifteen finer questions. ALL typography will be added afterwards with actual fonts. No words, letters, numbers, formulas, symbols that look like text, pseudo-text, legends, watermark, or title.

Image references supplied: the NIST circular lifecycle figure illustrates concentric fan hierarchy only; the NIST risk-functions figure illustrates grouping and a restrained semantic icon. These are independent references, not a diagram to copy. Disregard their text and dark/saturated palettes. Do not reproduce their four themes. The requested topology below is authoritative.

Create a large square canvas, ideally 1536 by 1536, pure white. Put the common center at (768,768), with a clean white circular hub radius about 155. Concentric bands span radii about 155–320 (major themes), 320–495 (eight subthemes), and 495–700 (finer questions). All rings are perfectly flat, front-facing, circular, thin smooth outlines. The hub stays empty for three or four lines of later typography.

Use screen angles increasing clockwise: right is zero degrees, bottom is 90, left is 180, top is 270. Three main theme sectors: blue from 270 through 360 to 45 degrees (135 degrees); soft green from 45 to 180 degrees (135 degrees); peach/coral from 180 to 270 degrees (90 degrees). These THREE sectors fill the first band. The second band divides the blue sector into exactly THREE equal 45-degree subthemes: 270–315, 315–360, 0–45. Divide the green sector into exactly THREE equal 45-degree subthemes: 45–90, 90–135, 135–180. Divide the peach/coral sector into exactly TWO equal 45-degree subthemes: 180–225, 225–270. Thus EXACTLY EIGHT subtheme wedges total, no extra divider strokes.

The outermost band exists only for FIVE subthemes that each have three leaves. Blue 270–315 has three equal 15-degree leaf wedges; blue 315–360 has three equal 15-degree leaf wedges; blue 0–45 has NO outer band at all. Green 45–90 has three equal 15-degree leaf wedges; green 90–135 has three equal 15-degree leaf wedges; green 135–180 has NO outer band at all. Peach/coral 180–225 has three equal 15-degree leaf wedges; peach/coral 225–270 has NO outer band at all. Therefore EXACTLY FIFTEEN thin outer leaf wedges, and white space where outer leaves are absent. The ring shapes and subdivisions express the hierarchy directly. No arrows, boxes, spokes crossing through the hub, decorative dots, floating nodes, or extra rings.

Semantic palette: Lancet blue #7B95C6, green #67A583, orange #F59C7C. Major band use about 25% of its hue mixed with opaque white; middle band about 18%; outer band about 12–18%, all very pale uniform fills. Use slightly darker muted borders of the same hue, not thick black. No gradients, paper/canvas texture, noise, waves, ripples, bands, clouding, glare, shadow, or 3D. Each contiguous fill has a completely even color. Keep generous white margin.

Place exactly ONE small flat line icon in EACH of the three major theme sectors, and none in the other bands. Blue: a magnifying lens with tiny connected points (problem and information). Green: one branching sprout-like graph (generalization). Peach: a simple compact gear (implementation). Use compact monochrome flat 2D line drawings in each group's own muted hue, no icon badge plate. Icon size roughly 42px. Locate each near its major-sector middle angle, toward the left side of a clear tangential title area, and leave a neighbouring blank area wide enough for 5–6 Chinese characters. Titles will be added snugly next to icons, so never center a large icon in the only text area. The rest of every sector must be open blank space for real text; do not add decoration or simulated writing. Preserve precise counts and clean typography space.
